title: Content package
description: One ready-to-render video idea. Files live in content/queue/<id>.json. The daily job renders the oldest one (by file name), uploads it and moves it to content/published/.

id.description: Date the idea was created + slug, e.g. 2026-10-15-doorway-effect. Also the file name.

topic.description: One of the topics listed in channel.yml

title.description: Curiosity-driven title, under 70 characters is ideal. No < or > characters (YouTube rejects them).

scenes.description: Spoken script, one entry per visual scene. Scene 1 is the hook (max ~12 words, must create an open loop). Total length 60-130 words.

text.description: Exactly what the voice says. One or two short sentences.

keywords.description: 2-4 concrete, visual words for stock-footage search, e.g. 'brain neurons glowing', 'octopus underwater', 'city street night'.

description.description: 2-5 lines. First line restates the hook. Hashtags and footer are appended automatically.

tags.description: Plain search tags. All tags together must stay under 500 characters.

hashtags.description: Added to the description. YouTube shows the first three above the title. #shorts is added if missing.

sources.description: Where the fact was verified. Listed at the end of the description.

cta.description: Overrides cta.text; empty string disables the spoken call-to-action for this video

thumbnail_text.description: Big text on the generated thumbnail; defaults to the hook

priority.description: Higher goes out first (default 0). Use 5-10 only for ideas with clear breakout potential.

first_comment.description: The channel's own first comment once the video is public: a question that invites replies, or a bonus fact. Defaults to the question at the end of the description.
